key_decisions.decision: Keep Chronicles’ exact totals and repeat the military qualification.
Retain all three durations, both swords, and the full territorial threat.
Retain the temporal tension of destruction and relenting, and Ornan’s identity.
Keep the sheep image, David’s responsibility, and the appeal involving his family.
Retain the angel, four sons, and wheat without substituting Samuel’s king reading.
Retain gold, six hundred, and the site rather than harmonizing Samuel’s silver price.
